title: Prevent context packing from truncating required rule includes
starting_state: A required context section expands rule includes near the end of the token budget.
The context loader silently truncates it, dropping a hard-fail rule fragment.
done_when: Required rule-include sections fail loudly rather than truncating mid-rule.
Context loader tests cover the error.
Agentic OS context rendering still works for the default manifest.
forbidden_changes: Do not increase the budget just to hide truncation.
Do not make required rule sections optional.
fail_to_pass: required rule includes near the budget boundary fail loudly instead of truncating silently
pass_to_pass: default Agentic OS context rendering still succeeds within budget
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should use a synthetic manifest with {{rule:palette}} near the budget boundary.
